scope: Multi-method tool fusing three live signal-representation branches: STFT, DWT, and Envelope. Mel and Clarke are deprecated comparison baselines.
architecture_logic: The pipeline is manifest-driven. validated_manifest.csv acts as the central gatekeeper, ensuring only verified high-quality raw data enters the processing stages.

pipeline_steps.name: PC Setup
pipeline_steps.description: Walks the dataset and builds the initial manifest. Run first on a new machine.

pipeline_steps.name: Validation
pipeline_steps.description: Gatekeeping step. Filters raw files based on NaN checks, clipping (>98% saturation), and RMS (0.001-50A).

pipeline_steps.name: Denoising
pipeline_steps.description: Applies 4th-order Butterworth bandpass (5-5000 Hz). ONLY processes files marked PASS or WARN in the manifest.

pipeline_steps.name: Split Generation
pipeline_steps.description: Canonical column-level stratified splits. Guarantees every (class, speed) pair is represented in train, val, and test.

variants.name: Mel STFT
variants.output: Mel-band features (.pt). Kept for the comparison table only.

variants.name: Clarke
variants.output: alpha/beta density histogram (.pt). Kept for the comparison table only.

variants.name: Envelope (1D spectrum)
variants.output: Envelope spectrum features (.pt, shape (3, 501)), per-channel PNGs

tasks.name: Train Clarke CNN
tasks.best_run: CLARKE_mod_alexnet_v1 (81.14% test acc; not used in best ensemble)

pipeline_steps.name: Final Deliverables
pipeline_steps.output: best_model.pt, Confusion Matrices, Per-class Metrics, Misclassification CSVs, Temperature-calibrated ensemble logits
pipeline_steps.description: Final diagnostic evidence for the research paper. Headline ensemble: ENSEMBLE_stft_dwt_envelope_temperature (96.49% test acc, 0.9524 macro-F1). Remaining errors concentrate on bearing bpfo 3 col5@100%.
